reviews.title: BEWARE! Avoid the Free Trial and Annual Subscription!
reviews.text:
I strongly urge others to think twice before even trying this app!

I signed up for a free trial and was charged $47.99 for an annual subscription. I canceled the subscription the very same day I was charged and immediately requested a refund. Despite my prompt action, Apple denied my refund twice!

I even contacted Apple Support and spoke with a senior advisor, only to discover that their system doesn’t provide any explanation for the denials and that no one could override the decision. How is that acceptable?

Now I’m stuck paying nearly $50 for an entire year of an app I never intended to keep or use. In today’s economy, $50 is a significant amount of money!

WARNING TO POTENTIAL CUSTOMERS: If you forget to cancel your free trial before it renews, you could be charged for an entire year with no guarantee of getting your money back, even if you cancel immediately afterward. That is exactly what happened to me.

The lack of transparency, flexibility, and accountability throughout this process has been absolutely unacceptable. Customers deserve better protection and a fair opportunity to resolve unwanted charges.

Based on my experience, I cannot recommend this app. My advice? Don’t even sign up for the free trial. It’s simply not worth the financial risk or frustration!

reviews.title: Oscillating, not binaural
reviews.text:
Perceiving binaural sound is an artifact of your brain processing two close but not identical frequencies. The perceived frequency is the difference between the two primary ones: eg if your right ear hears 4000Hz and your left ear hears 4002Hz, it will sound like the 4000Hz tone is “thrumming” at 2Hz.

There’s a very very simple test to determine whether an app is actually delivering binaural sound: just take out one earbud. If the perceived thrumming goes away in the remaining ear, it was binaural. If it stays, then it’s just a mono stream that seems to thrum…

This app fails, immediately and obviously. There may be a lot of very pleasant sounds in their library, but their primary claim is patently false. I don’t trust anything else they say, and neither should you.
